script: How to export vegetables from Bangladesh? Stop buying from random markets.
One: buy from fixed farms with spray records, so residue tests pass.
Two: inspect at the Shyampur packing house for your phytosanitary certificate.
Three: start with Middle East buyers, ship by air, keep it cold.
Then list your produce on Exportain, and let buyers find you.
